messages:
claire (PM): ACME pilot request: 'burst window' objective — target 99.95% success for requests from their reserved pool measured in 15m windows. They want p90/p95 queue-depth driven autoscale hooks, prewarm webhook, QA checklist, and audit logs. Can we scope a safe pilot commit by EOW? cc @anne @raj @olivia

anne (Eng): Clarify: success = low errors (5xx) or latency for admitted requests? Different tasks.

raj (Infra): Their wording focused on errors/timeouts. For autoscale we can expose a webhook + prewarm API. If config is operator-facing YAML only, estimate ~2 sprints.

olivia (SRE): 99.95% in 15m windows is aggressive. We need automatic fallback (spill to hosted model) and a circuit breaker. Also a runbook.

sam (Support): They also want per-request audit logs and tenant traces. We can provide dashboards; need to confirm retention/PII.

claire (PM): Proposed pilot MVP:
- Operator-configurable autoscale triggers + webhook prewarm (soft prewarm)
- Canary cutover + automatic fallback to hosted model variant on errors
- QA acceptance checklist + cutover runbook

anne (Eng): If we keep UI out and make config YAML/operator-only, we can shorten timeline. Rough dev estimate: ~6 dev-weeks.

raj (Infra): Prototype config sketch:
```
autoscale:
  trigger:
    metric: queue_depth_p95
    threshold: 120
    window: 60s
  action:
    prewarm: 2-gpus
    timeout: 300s
```
Wire that to prewarm/autoscaler.

olivia (SRE): QA checklist highlights:
- Load test at 2x expected burst
- Chaos test: simulate GPU or region failure and verify fallback
- Canary traffic ramp + rollback thresholds
- Alerts: queue depth, tail latency, error rate

claire (PM): Draft acceptance items to share with ACME (label as 'pilot objective', not contractual):
- Pilot target defined: 15m window -> 99.95% success (pilot objective)
- Autoscale config example provided
- Canary plan and rollback criteria documented
- Telemetry access for ACME + retention policy stated
- Security: KMS/HSM check for keys used
- Cutover runbook with on-call contacts

marco (Legal): Don't promise an SLA without contract amendment. Call it a 'pilot target' and Legal will draft amendment if needed.

claire (PM): Will present as pilot target. Next steps: @anne attach estimates EOD tomorrow; @raj prototype webhook/config by Thu; @olivia benchmark plan by Wed; @sam confirm logging/retention with ACME. Reconvene Fri 11am unless blockers.

deploy-bot: ticket PIOT-342 created by @claire: "ACME dedicated burst pilot - autoscale hooks + QA"

anne (Eng): Will add estimates to ticket.

olivia (SRE): Will spin up test harness skeleton and share plan by Wed.

sam (Support): Will confirm logging needs with ACME and schedule cutover coverage.

claire (PM): Thanks all.
